lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Guys.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Did any of you check your email?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I have.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Apparently, the Ark is having a rough fiscal year.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: They want us to come up with some kind of event. A seasonal promotion, a pop-up shop, that sort of thing.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Classic email from the Central Government.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: That's rich.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: What have they ever done for us while we're out here busting our backs making a living?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Every quarter, it's something else with them.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: You can say that again.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Preach.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: This isn't right.
Why don't we simply ignore them?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I considered it.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I was planning on just going through the motions

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: in order to keep up appearances.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Hold a run-of-the-mill flash sale or something.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: But I don't really want to do that...

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: We can't allow Talentum's reputation to suffer.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: It's an activity organized by the Merchant Union. If we don't give it our all,

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: what will the consumers think?
They could feel like they'd been duped by you guys.
It could damage your brand image.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: That's precisely what I'm saying.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: All right then Rookie, have you got anything in mind?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Let's spitball some ideas.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Something where we'll come out smelling like roses.
Limited edition seasonal products?
What about a sales event centered on gaming?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Sweetie,

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: do you realize how much money and R&D we'd have to invest in order

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: to churn out new products for winter?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: We'd run ourselves ragged,

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: and all we'd have to show for it is a puny pop-up shop.
What about a sales event centered on gaming then?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Video games?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: What do those have to do with what we're discussing?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Wait, actually...

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: that might not be such a bad idea.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We can build up some hype to show that Talentum is taking the gaming industry to the next level.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: And most importantly, we don't have to make any new products.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Plus, we already have a professional that we can consult.
Who?
You don't mean...

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: That's right, you!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: You're always in your room playing video games with Exia.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You and her camp in there practically every night

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: twiddling your joysticks.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Are we all in agreement?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: I'm in.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Rookie...

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We'll leave the rest to you.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Agreed!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: No one is more qualified to handle this than you, Sweetie!
But I'm not even a member of your squad...

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: So long as we've got financial support and the right people backing us,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I think we'll be able to pull this oval.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: ... I'll assume that's a typo?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Ugh, stupid predictive text.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: It's the bane of my existence.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Anyway, we're counting on you, Client.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: With your help, we'll have ourselves a grand year-end event that gamers will love.
Sounds like you're passing the buck if you ask me...
No one replies anymore...
